title: Objects shot on one backdrop: gapless gallery and care questions
when: Every product photo shares one backdrop; care, packaging or custom orders are the buyer's questions.

steps.note: Apply over `pdp-classic-2col` for the modules. No try-on advantages.
A grid works too: count a multiple of the columns.
Care, packaging, custom orders: the merchant's answers.

The store-wide subscription keeps the preset chosen on home: `section set` restyles it on every page. Only where it already sits on this page: `section add` makes an independent copy, not the shared one.

notes: On phones keep at most 3 blocks under the product card: the similar shelf, recently viewed and one chapter. Never copy home story grids under the product.

Before publishing, preview the product page: no «we do not deliver to this city» line (else `pdp-modules-prelaunch`), advantages only confirmed policies, no technical names in the chips. See references/product-page.md.
